question: Rita Mustaphi who is honoured with Mcknight Fellowship of 2023 for her excellent innovation in which of the following Indian Dance Forms?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kathak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kathak** is one of the eight major **classical dance forms of India**.
 
• The word **Kathak** is derived from the Sanskrit word **'Katha'**, which means **storytelling**.
